truist-arena.mobility.1.text: The arena offers wheelchair seating at all price levels and up to three companion tickets when available. Some sections may be unavailable because of production requirements. Request accessible seating when buying tickets; call the box office at 859-292-2889 for event-specific arrangements.
truist-arena.mobility.1.reason: Retain production-dependent section availability and event-specific seating contact alongside price-level and companion-ticket conditions.
truist-arena.mobility.1.quote: All sections may not be available due to production requirements. For event-specific information, please call the Truist Arena Box Office at: (859) 292-2889. Truist Arena meets or exceeds all structural and service requirements as stipulated by the Americans with Disabilities Act. Restrooms, drinking fountains, Truist Arena ATMs, and counters are accessible to guests with disabilities. Wheelchair accessible seats are available in all price levels. Up to three companion tickets, as available, may be purchased with each wheelchair accessible ticket. Please indicate when purchasing tickets if you require accessible seating.

truist-arena.mobility.3.text: The arena offers wheelchair assistance to and from seats on a first-come, first-served basis. Ask Guest Services; during an event, notify the nearest staff member. Wheelchairs are limited and cannot be borrowed or rented as seating during the event.
truist-arena.mobility.3.reason: Restore first-come availability, limited equipment and the correct assistance-request procedure.
truist-arena.mobility.3.quote: Truist Arena offers wheelchair service for guests who may need assistance to and from their seats. Please contact a Guest Services representative for assistance. Wheelchair assistance is provided on a first-come, first-served basis. Due to the limited number of wheelchairs available, they may not be borrowed or rented as seating during an event. If wheelchair assistance is necessary during an event, please notify the nearest staff member.

truist-arena.mobility.4.text: The arena generally permits disability drop-off at the front circle, reached from Nunn Drive. Event traffic arrangements may change this; check the event page. The East Concourse entrance is beside Lot O, and the arena requires a valid disability parking placard for accessible parking spaces.
truist-arena.mobility.4.reason: Retain Nunn Drive approach and event-dependent drop-off arrangements without treating the general route as guaranteed for every event.
quote: In general, patrons with disabilities may be dropped off at the drop-off circle in front of the arena. One should enter the campus of Northern Kentucky University from Nunn Drive in order to access the drop-off area. Click here for the NKU Campus Map. Some events at Truist Arena may have the Northern Kentucky Department of Public Safety directing traffic to and from Truist Arena. When an event calls for this, specific information concerning accessibility drop-off will be posted an events specific event page on the Truist Arena website. Accessible Parking Accessible parking spaces are located in the adjacent surface lot (Lot O) & in the Welcome Center Garage. You must have a valid person with a disabled parking placard to park. One should enter the campus of Northern Kentucky University from Nunn Drive in order to access accessible parking close to the arena. Click here for the NKU Campus Map. Parking is first-come first-served and spaces are limited. An early arrival is strongly recommended. Shuttle service may be offered in some circumstances. Please refer to a specific event page if shuttle service is being offered.
The secondary, East Concourse entrance, is located on the east side of the building next to Lot O.

truist-arena.chronic.3.text: The arena lists 30 restrooms, including one unisex family restroom, and describes all of them as accessible to people with disabilities. Dimensions, transfer arrangements and adult changing equipment are not specified in this statement.
truist-arena.chronic.3.reason: Attribute the venue’s broad restroom description; do not convert it into an independently measured assessment or adult-changing claim.
truist-arena.chronic.3.quote: Truist Arena offers a total of 30 restrooms including 1 unisex family restroom, all accessible to persons with disabilities.
